name: bdf_get_ecb_policy_rate
description:
An ECB key interest rate in percent: ecb_main_refi (main refinancing operations, fixed rate), ecb_deposit (deposit facility) or ecb_marginal_lending (marginal lending facility), series FM.B.U2.EUR.4F.KR.*.LEV. Observations are the dates the rate changed, so the last one is the rate in force.
Returns: series_code (ECB flow.key), series_id, label, unit, unit_multiplier, frequency, source, observation_count and observations (date, value) oldest first; a note when the period has no observations.
Inputs (none required): rate_type (ecb_main_refi, ecb_deposit, ecb_marginal_lending; default ecb_main_refi); start_date, end_date (YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM or YYYY); recent_periods (1-100; default 10; the last N observations, used only when neither date is given).
The same rates and the euro STR are in ecb_get_interest_rate.
Example: {"rate_type": "ecb_deposit", "recent_periods": 5}
